_readme: Every image the showcase tenant publishes, and what it says about each one.
Adding a work is: drop the file next to this manifest and add a row. No code
changes, no migration. `file` is relative to backend/seed-assets/.
CATEGORIES ARE DERIVED, NOT DECLARED. `categories` below is a dictionary of
available drawers; only the ones some PUBLISHED work actually files itself
under are created on the tenant. A filter button that opens onto nothing is
worse than no filter button, and the only way to guarantee that never
happens is to refuse to create the drawer before the work exists. `portrait`
is here and unused on purpose: it is the shape of the studio's curriculum,
waiting for a painting.
`state` is active / draft / archived — the tenant keeps every work at every
state, and the plan decides only how many of the active ones get published.
`rank` orders the six featured works; the home preview and the archive page
share that one ordering.
Studio work and student work are separate lists because they answer separate
questions — 'how good is the person teaching me' and 'what could I make
here' — and because only one of them needs a consent record. `student` is
an index into showcase_content.STUDENTS, so the credit on the public page
and the record in the CMS name the same person.
`consent` is confirmed (default) or withdrawn, and it is a STUDENT-level
fact, separate from the per-work `shared` flag. Both gates must be open
for a piece to appear publicly. One entry here is withdrawn on purpose:
a demo where consent has only ever been granted proves nothing about what
happens when it is taken back.
Images are WebP at 1600px: the derivative pipeline caps at 2000px anyway,
and the source PNGs were 75 MB, which every deploy bundle would have
carried for the rest of the product's life. The three original works stay
PNG because deploy/aws/verify_release_bundles.sh pins them by name.

caption.zh: 布面油画与炭笔，90 × 90 cm，2025。风停之后那半小时，树还没缓过来。
caption.en: Oil and charcoal on canvas, 90 × 90 cm, 2025. The half hour after the wind drops, when the trees have not caught up yet.

caption.zh: 布面油画，60 × 60 cm，2025。柠檬是课上剩下的，摆了一周才画。
caption.en: Oil on canvas, 60 × 60 cm, 2025. The lemon was left over from a class and sat there a week before I painted it.

caption.zh: 布面油画，刮刀，75 × 75 cm，2024。桅杆先画，剩下的都是为了托住它们。
caption.en: Oil on canvas, palette knife, 75 × 75 cm, 2024. The masts went in first; everything else is there to hold them up.

caption.zh: 布面丙烯与油彩，80 × 80 cm，2025。夜里画的，第二天看颜色全对，很少这样。
caption.en: Acrylic and oil on canvas, 80 × 80 cm, 2025. Painted at night, and the colour still read true the next morning — which is rare.

caption.zh: 布面油画，刮刀，60 × 60 cm，2024。风大的那种下午，海是灰绿的，草是热的。
caption.en: Oil on canvas, palette knife, 60 × 60 cm, 2024. One of those windy afternoons — the sea grey-green, the grass still warm.

caption.zh: 布面油画，70 × 70 cm，2024。开车去 Castlemaine 的路上，停了二十分钟。
caption.en: Oil on canvas, 70 × 70 cm, 2024. Twenty minutes at the side of the road on the way to Castlemaine.

caption.zh: 布面油画与拼贴，70 × 70 cm，2025。近处的叶子和远处的海，是同一种蓝。
caption.en: Oil and collage on canvas, 70 × 70 cm, 2025. The leaves in front and the sea behind turned out to be the same blue.

caption.zh: 布面油画，65 × 65 cm，2024。草比水难画，因为草会动。
caption.en: Oil on canvas, 65 × 65 cm, 2024. The grass was harder than the water, because grass moves.

caption.zh: 布面油画，70 × 70 cm，2025。院子里的树，背后是想象的海。
caption.en: Oil on canvas, 70 × 70 cm, 2025. A tree from the courtyard, with a sea that is not there.

caption.zh: 纸本油彩，50 × 50 cm，2025。一节课的时间，一个东西。
caption.en: Oil on paper, 50 × 50 cm, 2025. One class, one object.

caption.zh: 布面油画，60 × 60 cm，2024。退潮的沙滩有六种颜色，我只画得出四种。
caption.en: Oil on canvas, 60 × 60 cm, 2024. Wet sand at low tide has six colours in it; I got four.

caption.zh: 水彩与水粉，40 × 40 cm，2025。窗台上放了三天的一把花，第二天开始掉，画的是第三天。
caption.en: Watercolour and gouache, 40 × 40 cm, 2025. A bunch left on the sill for three days. It started dropping on the second; this is the third.

caption.zh: 炭笔与色粉，纸本，50 × 50 cm，2025。它在窗外待了十分钟，够画个大概。
caption.en: Charcoal and pastel on paper, 50 × 50 cm, 2025. It stayed outside the window for about ten minutes — enough for the shape of it.

caption.zh: 布面油画，80 × 80 cm，在画。椅子还不对，先不放上去。
caption.en: Oil on canvas, 80 × 80 cm, in progress. The chair is still wrong, so it stays off the site for now.

caption.zh: 布面油画，70 × 70 cm，2023。2024 年个展之后收起来了，留在记录里。
caption.en: Oil on canvas, 70 × 70 cm, 2023. Taken down after the 2024 show, kept on the record.

caption.zh: Priya，来了三个月。第一次把影子画成有颜色的。
caption.en: Priya, three months in. The first time she painted a shadow that had a colour in it.

caption.zh: Ana，周三上午班。照着自家后院画的。
caption.en: Ana, Wednesday morning class, from her own back garden.

caption.zh: Xi，第二学期。这只瓶子他画了四遍，这是第四遍。
caption.en: Xi, second term. He painted this vase four times; this is the fourth.

caption.zh: Hana，来了半年。海的三条横线是一口气画完的。
caption.en: Hana, six months in. The three strokes of sea went down in one go.

caption.zh: Lucy，油画基础班。第一张自己带材料来画的。
caption.en: Lucy, foundation oil. The first one she brought her own subject for.

caption.zh: Xiaoman，周日水彩班。她说这张只关于颜色，不关于东西。
caption.en: Xiaoman, Sunday watercolour. She says this one is about colour, not about things.

caption.zh: Eli，9 岁，周六儿童班。
caption.en: Eli, aged 9, Saturday children's class.

caption.zh: Xiaoyu，8 岁，周六儿童班。家长后来撤回了公开同意——这一张留在后台，不在网站上。
caption.en: Xiaoyu, aged 8, Saturday children's class. Consent was withdrawn afterwards, so this one stays in the console and off the site.
